meta.title: Suggestion review queue - choose the best path BEFORE anything is implemented
meta.author: arena/4a709dd0-korea2
meta.workflow: Every suggestion carries options with trade-offs, an effort/impact estimate, and a recommended path. Status moves: proposed -> chosen (owner picks an option) -> implementing -> done. Nothing is implemented until an option is chosen; the 'recommended' field is advice, not a decision.
meta.duplicate_note: Earlier suggestion hubs (suggestions/, decision-desk, decision-hub, review-board) remain live. This queue does not replace them; S-04 proposes consolidation.

rows.title: Adopt the price-snapshot store and verified results feed as the canonical data layer
rows.problem: Market snapshots and results were scattered across labs with no single store recording open/close per originated market.

options.path: A: link price-desk from root nav now, consolidate later
options.trade-offs: fast, no risk to existing labs; duplication remains short-term

options.path: B: fold the store into the root pipeline immediately
options.trade-offs: single source of truth faster; touches files owned by root pipeline; higher regression risk

rows.title: Build the official-gamebook ingestion pipeline (scores, starters, inactives, weather)
rows.problem: Verification is manual; 931 results rows are archive-only; replacement depth and per-game official weather have no feed.

options.path: A: GitHub Action that fetches each week's gamebooks (PDF) and extracts score/lineups/weather into the results feed, opening PRs only (fail-closed)
options.trade-offs: automates everything downstream (Q-02/Q-03/Q-04/Q-09); needs PDF parsing + rate-limit care; run cost per week

options.path: B: manual transcription per week
options.trade-offs: no code; slow, error-prone, not scalable

options.path: C: leave as-is and verify on demand
options.trade-offs: zero effort; the verified feed stays tiny and decisions stay blocked

rows.title: Source opening-line data (or retire opening-value strategies)
rows.problem: The snapshot store's open columns are blank for the whole window (PS-F-01); OPEN_EDGE strategies cannot be validated.

options.path: A: licensed odds feed / book partnership (research licence)
options.trade-offs: only genuinely official route; cost + negotiation; solves Q-01

options.path: B: begin our own point-in-time snapshots from any licensed feed going forward
options.trade-offs: self-sustaining from day one; no history

options.path: C: retire opening-value features until data exists
options.trade-offs: honest; loses a strategy family

rows.recommended: A then B (B can start immediately regardless)

rows.title: Consolidate the duplicated hubs and navigation
rows.problem: Twelve-plus session hubs (dashboard, nfl-lines, nfl-research, research-desk, quant-lab, origination-lab, origination, skill-lab, suggestions, verify-hub, decision-desk, decision-hub, site, nfl-command, lineup-lab, review-board, coverage) each with their own pages; nav and 'suggestions' entry points are duplicated (PS-F-13).

options.path: A: freeze old hubs as archive, one live hub per category
options.trade-offs: clean UX; needs a mapping pass; old deep links must keep resolving

options.path: B: keep all hubs, maintain one curated index page
options.trade-offs: no breakage; navigation stays heavy

options.path: C: full restructure into a single app
options.trade-offs: best end state; highest risk to a site that currently builds and deploys cleanly

rows.recommended: B now, A after the current review backlog clears

rows.title: Fix the model-calibration defects in scripts/analyze_model.py (issue #9)
rows.problem: Sigma is fitted on holdout residuals that are then evaluated (leakage); a misnamed baseline key (0.25); missing tie term in away_fair.

options.path: A: refit sigma on the training window only, rename the key, add the tie term, add regression tests
options.trade-offs: small diff, closes the issue honestly; published calibration numbers will move

options.path: B: label all calibration outputs provisional and defer
options.trade-offs: zero code; trust stays blocked (Q-08)

rows.title: Decide the rewards model (fund / virtualize / remove)
rows.problem: Rewards language exists while the pool is unfunded and no strategy is eligible (PS-F-07).

options.path: A: explicitly virtual points, no monetary language anywhere
options.trade-offs: honest, cheap; less motivating

options.path: B: fund a prize pool
options.trade-offs: motivating; costs money; needs rules/legal

options.path: C: remove rewards until a strategy passes gates
options.trade-offs: cleanest; loses the competition framing the brief asks for

rows.recommended: A now; revisit B when a strategy passes the gates

rows.title: Approve or revise the demotion-gate parameters
rows.problem: The demotion gate is proposed but unenforced; parameters need an owner decision.

options.path: A: adopt as proposed (100-bet window, p > 0.10, 25% drawdown, 1 re-promotion/season)
options.trade-offs: balanced; matches the earlier quant-lab sketch's 100-bet figure

options.path: B: stricter (50-bet window, p > 0.05, 15% drawdown)
options.trade-offs: faster demotion; more false demotions on noise

options.path: C: looser (150-bet window, p > 0.20, 35% drawdown)
options.trade-offs: fewer false demotions; slower to catch decay

rows.title: Remove the committed virtualenv (.venv-b6, 6,214 tracked files) from git
rows.problem: A Python virtualenv is tracked in git (PR #97 even modifies its files). It bloats the repo and risks accidental dependency churn in reviews.

options.path: A: git rm -r --cached .venv-b6 + add to .gitignore + document the Python setup in README
options.trade-offs: clean history going forward; one large deletion commit

options.path: B: keep it as a convenience runtime
options.trade-offs: works offline; unconventional; keeps polluting diffs

rows.recommended: A (owner decision - it may be deliberate)

rows.title: Resolve the three stale sibling PRs (#93 conflicting, #97 venv-only, #99 review-board)
rows.problem: Three PRs from idle sessions are open; #93 conflicts with main, #97's non-venv diff is only .gitignore, #99 is review-board-only and mergeable.

options.path: A: re-verify and merge #99; ask owners to rebase #93; close or rework #97
options.trade-offs: keeps sibling work; requires checks to pass

options.path: B: close all three with notes
options.trade-offs: clean board; discards work (against project rules)

rows.title: Recompute correlations on the verified subset and publish both versions
rows.problem: Correlations are archive-based (Q-03); R7 requires officially sourced numbers.

options.path: A: as the verified feed grows (S-02), recompute each correlation on the verified subset and publish archive vs verified side by side with n for each
options.trade-offs: honest progress; verified n will be small at first

options.path: B: wait until the feed is complete
options.trade-offs: simpler; delays everything
